regimeDescription: Mixed — no clear dominant macro regime; signals are contradictory or low-conviction
supportingEvidence: Commodity complex showing inflation persistence — oil and/or gold trending higher
Growth proxies deteriorating — SPX under pressure and/or VIX rising
Breadth divergence — SPX/BTC divergence or narrow leadership visible
watchLevels: VIX 30 — a sustained breach confirms stress escalation; break below signals relief
WTI $90+ — key level where energy costs begin to feed into broader CPI expectations
Gold $2,400 — sustained hold signals institutional inflation hedging in force
SPX 200-day MA — key structural support; break and hold below shifts trend regime
10Y Treasury 4.5% — yield boundary between equity-supportive and equity-restrictive regimes
invalidationConditions: Any two dimensions align strongly in one direction — regime will clarify
VIX spikes above 30 — even mixed regime becomes risk-off if vol escalates
